# Jaipur Eye & Dental Hospital (JEDH) — Full Context

> Jaipur Eye & Dental Hospital (JEDH) is a comprehensive eye and dental care hospital in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India, operating since 2017. Led by MS and MDS qualified specialists, JEDH has treated 20,000+ patients with a 4.8-star Google rating (20,000+ reviews) and 4.9-star JustDial rating (2,334 reviews).

## About JEDH

JEDH provides specialized ophthalmology and dentistry services under one roof at Plot No. 1, Near Vidhan Sabha, Lalkothi, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302015, India. The hospital was founded in 2017 by Dr. Amit Gupta (MS Ophthalmology) and Dr. Nehal Gupta (MDS Prosthodontics). The team includes 6 specialist doctors covering cataract surgery, LASIK, glaucoma, retina care, dental implants, Invisalign, cosmetic dentistry, and oral surgery.

### Key Achievements
- 20,000+ patients treated since 2017
- 10,000+ successful eye surgeries
- 5,000+ dental patients
- 4.8-star Google rating with 20,000+ reviews
- 4.9-star JustDial rating with 2,334 reviews
- 32,000+ YouTube subscribers with 534+ videos and 2.7M+ views
- Empaneled with RGHS, CGHS, and 25+ insurance providers

## Eye Care Services

### Cataract Surgery
- **Page:** https://jaipureyedental.com/eye/cataract-surgery.html
- **Techniques:** Phacoemulsification (Phaco) and Femtosecond laser-assisted cataract surgery
- **IOL Options:** Monofocal, Toric (for astigmatism), Multifocal, EDOF (Extended Depth of Focus), Trifocal
- **Pricing:**
  - Indian IOL: ₹18,000 - ₹25,000/eye
  - Imported Monofocal IOL: ₹30,000 - ₹45,000/eye
  - Multifocal IOL: ₹55,000 - ₹75,000/eye
  - Toric IOL: ₹65,000 - ₹85,000/eye
  - Trifocal IOL: ₹95,000 - ₹1,25,000/eye
- **Procedure Time:** 10-15 minutes per eye
- **Recovery:** Light activities next day, full recovery 4-6 weeks
- **Insurance:** Covered under RGHS, CGHS, and most insurance providers

### LASIK & PRK Laser Eye Surgery
- **Page:** https://jaipureyedental.com/eye/lasik-prk.html
- **Options:** Bladeless Femto LASIK, PRK/TransPRK, Contoura Vision (topography-guided LASIK)
- **Pricing:**
  - LASIK Basic (Femto): ₹35,000 - ₹45,000/eye
  - LASIK Contoura Vision: ₹55,000 - ₹70,000/eye
  - PRK/TransPRK: ₹40,000 - ₹55,000/eye
  - ICL (Implantable Collamer Lens): ₹85,000 - ₹1,15,000/eye
- **Candidacy:** Adults 18+ with stable prescription for 1+ year, no active eye disease
- **Procedure Time:** 10-15 minutes per eye
- **Recovery:** LASIK: 2-3 days. PRK: 5-7 days.
- **Success Rate:** 95%+ patients achieve 6/6 (20/20) vision

### Glaucoma Treatment
- **Page:** https://jaipureyedental.com/eye/glaucoma.html
- **Services:** Screening, medical management (eye drops), laser therapy (SLT, YAG PI), surgical options (trabeculectomy, glaucoma implants)
- **Key Message:** Early detection prevents irreversible vision loss

### Pediatric Eye Care & Myopia Control
- **Page:** https://jaipureyedental.com/eye/pediatric-myopia.html
- **Services:** Myopia control (atropine drops, ortho-K, multifocal contact lenses), amblyopia (lazy eye) treatment, pediatric eye exams, squint correction

## Dental Care Services

### Dental Implants
- **Page:** https://jaipureyedental.com/dental/implants.html
- **Systems:** Korean implants (cost-effective), German Premium (Straumann/Nobel Biocare class), German Elite (highest tier)
- **Technology:** 3D CBCT scanning for precise placement
- **Pricing:**
  - Korean Implant: ₹25,000 - ₹35,000/tooth
  - German Premium Implant: ₹50,000 - ₹70,000/tooth
  - German Elite Implant: ₹80,000 - ₹1,00,000/tooth
- **Process:** 3-stage: implant placement → 3-6 months osseointegration → final crown
- **Longevity:** 20+ years with proper care (Source: JADA long-term survival data)

### Invisalign Clear Aligners
- **Page:** https://jaipureyedental.com/dental/invisalign.html
- **Options:** Invisalign Lite (minor corrections) and Invisalign Comprehensive (complex cases)
- **Pricing:**
  - Invisalign Lite: ₹75,000 - ₹1,00,000
  - Invisalign Comprehensive: ₹1,50,000 - ₹2,50,000
- **Duration:** 6-18 months depending on complexity
- **Provider:** Certified Invisalign provider

### Cosmetic Dentistry
- **Page:** https://jaipureyedental.com/dental/cosmetic.html
- **Services:** Teeth whitening, porcelain veneers, dental bonding, smile makeovers, tooth contouring

### Preventive Dental Care
- **Page:** https://jaipureyedental.com/dental/preventive.html
- **Services:** Dental cleanings, fluoride treatments, dental sealants, oral health assessments, gum disease screening

## Insurance & Payment

- **Government Schemes:** RGHS (Rajasthan Government Health Scheme), CGHS (Central Government Health Scheme)
- **Private Insurance:** 25+ major providers with cashless treatment
- **Payment Options:** Cash, cards, UPI, EMI options available
- **Pricing Page:** https://jaipureyedental.com/pricing.html

## NRI & Medical Tourism

JEDH serves international patients from the USA, UK, Middle East, and worldwide with comprehensive medical tourism packages.

### For USA Patients
- **Page:** https://jaipureyedental.com/nri/usa.html
- **Savings:** 60-80% compared to US costs
- **Services:** End-to-end coordination including appointment scheduling, travel guidance, and post-operative care

### For UK Patients
- **Page:** https://jaipureyedental.com/nri/uk.html
- **Advantage:** Affordable alternative to NHS waiting lists
- **Quick turnaround:** Most procedures completed within 1-2 weeks

### For Middle East Patients
- **Page:** https://jaipureyedental.com/nri/middle-east.html
- **Quick turnaround:** Optimized scheduling for short visits
- **Proximity:** Short flight from UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar
